theme_and_art_direction.concept: The Elevated Pokéball - Swiss Brutalism meets Luxury Portfolio
theme_and_art_direction.description: An Awwwards-worthy, edgy, and highly kinetic portfolio for creative developer 'Alex Carter'. The design abstracts the Pokéball concept into a premium, sophisticated execution. Instead of childish graphics, it uses a strict Swiss-inspired palette of Obsidian Black, Pure White, and Signal Red. The site features bold kinetic typography, masked text reveals, real photography in clipped frames, and purposeful premium motion.
theme_and_art_direction.persona: Alex Carter - Creative Developer (Edgy, Sophisticated, Technical)

fonts.headings: Cabinet Grotesk, Clash Display, or Anton
fonts.body: IBM Plex Mono or JetBrains Mono
fonts.accents: Inter (only for small ui labels, not main text)

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none uppercase
hierarchy.h2_section: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-none uppercase

intro_animation_spec.interaction: Static on load, waiting for a user click. Upon clicking the center, the top half slides up and the bottom half slides down, revealing the kinetic hero section beneath.

technical_execution.wrapper: fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex flex-col cursor-pointer
technical_execution.top_half: h-1/2 w-full bg-[#FF3B30] flex items-end justify-center relative border-b-[4px] border-[#0A0A0A] origin-top
technical_execution.bottom_half: h-1/2 w-full bg-[#FFFFFF] flex items-start justify-center relative origin-bottom
technical_execution.center_button: absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-24 h-24 bg-[#FFFFFF] rounded-full border-[8px] border-[#0A0A0A] flex items-center justify-center z-[101] shadow-2xl transition-transform hover:scale-110
technical_execution.framer_motion: Wrap halves in <motion.div>. On click state 'isOpen=true', animate top_half y to '-100%', bottom_half y to '100%', center_button scale to 0 and opacity to 0. Use an easing like [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1] for a premium, heavy cinematic feel.

header.style: Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/70`) with subtle bottom border (`border-white/10`). Never fully transparent.
header.content: Minimalist logo (Alex Carter) on left, 3-4 nav links on right, no hamburger menu on desktop.

hero.content: Massive masked line-by-line text reveal: 'CREATIVE' (line 1), 'DEVELOPER' (line 2). Subtle 3D or parallax abstract background. A refined call-to-action.

about.style: Numbered manifesto chapters. High typographic contrast.
about.content: Large numbers (01, 02) paired with bold statements. Real photography avatar in a clipped, non-standard frame (e.g., tight vertical rectangle).

skills.content: Massive outline text (`text-8xl+ text-transparent font-black stroke-white`) scrolling very slowly using `react-fast-marquee`. Mixed with subtle tech icons.

projects.content: 4 realistic sample projects. Mix wide and tall cards. Images use `bg-black/40` overlay to ensure text contrast. Use hover effects that slightly scale the image and reveal project details.

contact.content: Huge text 'LET'S TALK' at `text-[10vw]`. Red accent button. Darker background tone than the rest of the site (e.g., solid `#000000`).

motion_and_interaction.scroll: MANDATORY: Use `lenis` for smooth momentum scrolling. It gives the site weight and premium feel.
motion_and_interaction.reveals: Use `framer-motion` for scroll-triggered reveals (`whileInView`). Do not animate everything; focus on text masks and staggered list items.
motion_and_interaction.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST explicitly set text color on hover. Use scale transitions (`active:scale-95`).

avatar.description: Artistic silhouette of a woman. Use in the About section.

project_1.description: Dark rippling water textures. Project 1 thumbnail.

project_2.description: Monochrome abstract layered lines. Project 2 thumbnail.

project_3.description: Red and black marbled pattern. Project 3 thumbnail.

project_4.description: Vivid red square on black. Project 4 thumbnail.

components_and_libraries.ui_primitives: Custom HTML/Tailwind for marketing layout. Avoid Shadcn for main structure to maintain creative freedom.
components_and_libraries.motion: framer-motion (required for intro and kinetic text)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure white text on obsidian black meets WCAG AAA. Ensure text over images has a gradient overlay or text-shadow.
accessibility.testing: All buttons, links, and forms MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="pokeball-intro-button"`).

universal_guidelines: No generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry and grids.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Never use purely transparent headers over content.
Never use placeholder URLs. Use the provided Pexels links.
Focus heavily on deep, rich layering (z-index hierarchy) and glassmorphism with inner borders.
